detail.longDescription: 🤖 Dell patches two max-severity (CVSS 10.0) flaws in Container Storage Modules (CSM) Authorization v2.4.0, which connects Dell storage arrays to Kubernetes. Missing authentication lets unauthenticated remote attackers grab backend admin credentials across all tenants. CVE-2026-63688, CVE-2026-63692. 🔗 https://www. dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-us/0 00515771 # CVE # CyberSec # Kubernetes # InfoSec
